name: s81sl_rs

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered (S81 slice ring stop leaf ot_s81sl_rs): every data input lands in a pin flop (iw / ie / iv / xf_q / neo_q / nwo_q / ci_q / sid_c and the 46 control copies' header / valid copies) and every output leaves a flop (ro_e / ro_w / vo / dl_* / nx_* relay registers, g_* gather registers, fault). recipe-3 pin_regs would add a second unpriced stage per ring hop (SPEC: +1 ring-stop register ~ +8 cycles per ring traversal) and break the landed-slice lockstep latencies.

fill_reason.pin_bound: Pin-bound leaf without macros: 15,180 signal pins (W / E 2,554 each = line in + out + xfin NX; N 4,150 control-plane deliveries / inject + V rung; S 4,492 gather word to the x streamer leaf + own fragments). Outline from face density <= 5.8 pins/um, not synthesis area (~15k um2 std).

structural_change: S81-XG3 (LEAD3-S81 10-19): the s81sl_xg tile (ring stop + x streamer, 38k flops on one root over 648 um; gates xgr CTS rc=137 / xgr2 DPL-0038 after 1.2M repair buffers, GPL overflow stuck 0.30) is split into two sibling hard leaves of the slice parent: this ring stop leaf ot_s81sl_rs and the x streamer leaf s81sl_xs3; ot_s81sl_xg is wiring only. ot_s81sl_rs = ot_s81sl_rstop RELAY=1 cycle-for-cycle (rs_equiv: 8 random protocol cases x 20k cycles, all outputs every edge, 0 mismatches; MUT_SLICE negative control FAILs), restructured as 46 bit slices of 24 b each with its own kept control copy (header pin-flop copies + fragment-state replicas) so no select drives more than ~24 b of the 1,104-b muxes; header bits [20:0] / scalar valids / faults from copy 0. g_d leaves on the S face in [49.68, 583.20] facing the x streamer leaf's N-face g_d range (same span), so the 3 x 1,031-b gather port is a straight registered abutment. SAFE checklist (owner 10-19): 1 pins waived-with-reason (source-registered: every input lands in a pin flop, every output leaves a relay flop; reset_landing 2 stages ON). 2 reach fixed: W pin -> E pin is iw flop -> line mux + ro_e_p -> ro_e_q relay (two hops of ~432 um at 864 wide). 3 fanout fixed: 46 kept control copies (ot_s81sl_rs_cc, keep_hierarchy, unparameterised so Yosys cannot rename it) each drive <= 24 b of every wide mux; reset via ot_rst_relay 4 regions. 4 depth PASS: 5:1 one-hot line mux + header format, no arithmetic beyond hops-1. 5 storage PASS: fragment slots 2 x 828 b written once per beat (no runtime index, no delay line). 6 floorplan waived-with-reason: pin-bound (no macros), outline from face pin density <= 5.8/um, not synthesis area. 7 clock: clock_split_km K=16 regional roots; spread judged TT+FF <= 80; io_hold_margin 0.03. 8 schedule: cycle-equal to ot_s81sl_rstop RELAY=1 (rs_equiv) -> no schedule change vs xgr.
